identity.original_title: Pay 2 Win: The World is Mine

hooks.text: 在二维工作室网格中相邻布置设施，触发增益、连锁与产出倍率来推动增长。
hooks.excerpt: Placing certain facilities together activates unique buffs, combos, and output multipliers that benefit your run, letting you reach greater levels and unlock new progression.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 同一局可走放置挂机路线，也可转向点击、冷却和增减益管理的主动玩法。
hooks.excerpt: Play a run in a standard idle fashion, gaining buffs and output bonuses based on leaving your game idle, or opt into more active playstyles and select facilities that work with click actions, managing cooldowns, juggling buffs and debuffs, and so much more!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 经营濒临倒闭的游戏工作室时，关键决策会改变问题处理方式与故事走向。
hooks.excerpt: How you do this is up to you - at key points in the story, you'll have the option to decide how best to approach problems, resolve scenarios, and alter the course of the story.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
